instruction: Change VLC's maximum volume limit to 200%.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated VLC advanced preferences (Tools > Preferences > All > Interface > Main interfaces > Qt) to disable the background cone icon, saved settings, and restarted VLC to verify the change.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VLC advanced preferences, find specific settings, toggle checkboxes, save preferences, restart VLC
metadata.task_rationale: Related VLC Qt preferences task: changing the maximum volume limit is in the same Qt interface settings area the model already navigated successfully, testing the ability to modify a numeric value instead of a checkbox.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's maximum volume to 200% via Qt preferences. Evaluator uses existing get_vlc_config getter to read vlcrc file, and check_qt_max_volume metric to verify qt-max-volume is set to 200. Default is 125.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter get_vlc_config correctly reads the vlcrc configuration file from the VM, which contains the qt-max-volume setting.
Metric check_qt_max_volume correctly parses vlcrc for 'qt-max-volume=' line, defaults to '125' if absent, and compares against expected value '200'.
Expected parameter handling is correct: with type='rule', get_rule returns {'expected_qt_max_volume': 200}, and the metric accesses rule['expected_qt_max_volume'] directly.
Postconfig kills VLC before reading config, ensuring vlcrc is flushed to disk with saved settings.
Full coverage: the single instruction requirement (max volume = 200%) is completely verified by the evaluator.
Expected value 200 correctly matches the instruction's '200%' requirement.
